title: OECS Payment Definitions
description: Defines how a driver can pay for a charging session: accepted payment methods, ad-hoc (no app/subscription) payment support, and any integrated payment terminal hardware.

paymentMethod.description: A way a driver can pay for a session, distinct from how they authenticate/start it (see hardware.userInterface.authenticationMethods).

paymentTerminal.description: Integrated payment card terminal hardware, if the charger accepts card payment directly rather than relying solely on an app/backend.

payment.description: Complete payment capability specification of the charger.

adHocPaymentSupported.description: Whether a driver can pay without a pre-existing app, subscription, or RFID card (e.g. tap a contactless bank card). Required for public DC chargers under regulations such as the EU AFIR.
